Increasing the height of control tower may become necessary. The glide slope-highway clearance requirements of this runway, however, would be adequate.
The length of Corridor #3 from the center of existing I-94 to a point east of Howell Avenue would be 1.66 miles.
With the interchange area at I-94 free of development and homes already removed from General Mitchell Field's Air Cargo Area it is estimated that a freeway facility in this corridor would displace 55 people from 15 housing units and 6 commercial units. The corridor, however, would not be compatible with General Mitchell Field's air cargo area expansion program.
